items.title: The lockdowns
items.line: By April about half the world was under some form of lockdown, more than 3.9 billion people in over 90 countries.

items.title: Animal Crossing: New Horizons
items.line: It came out March 20, just as lockdowns spread. Nintendo reported 11.77 million sold in 12 days, and people held weddings and graduations on their islands.

items.title: Tiger King
items.line: It hit Netflix on March 20, seven episodes about Joe Exotic and an Oklahoma zoo. Nielsen counted 34.3 million viewers in the first 10 days.

items.title: Zoom
items.line: Zoom said it had 10 million daily meeting participants in December 2019 and over 300 million by April 2020, a count it later walked back.

items.title: Among Us
items.line: Innersloth released it in 2018, and nobody cared until streamers found it in summer 2020. It hit about 1.5 million concurrent players in September.

items.title: The Queen's Gambit
items.line: It landed October 23. Netflix said 62 million households watched in its first month, and one US company reported chess set sales up over 1,000 percent.

items.title: The lofi girl gets pulled
items.line: In February 2020 YouTube briefly removed ChilledCow's lofi radio stream, then restored it after public backlash. Viewing grew through the pandemic.
